This issue might be a duplicate of existing issues. Please check:

- #45315: Empty completions with an unknown finish reason retry without any bound — identical root cause and loop behavior, includes a working repro with a local fake server and measured request counts
- #43622: Session exits silently (exit 0, no error) when a turn returns finish "unknown" — same predicate in prompt.ts, same code path analyzed
- #46415: finish_reason 'unknown' triggers assistant-prefill continuation — same loop-exit condition, affects SAP AI Core and other prefill-forbidding providers
- #45314: SAP AI Core / GPT models cause infinite agent loop — same symptom from the same root cause
- #43939: v1.18.21 repeatedly continues complete responses with finish=unknown — same issue reported against an earlier version

Update: after reducing the project from 581 active sessions to 40, the new UI started showing sessions again.

The remaining 40 sessions are not all visible in the main sidebar: 9 are root sessions and 31 have a parent_id. The current API/UI request uses roots=true / parentID=null, so only the 9 root sessions are returned by design.

This suggests two separate issues:
1. Large projects may be affected by list limits or broken pagination/rendering. In v1.18.31 the server default limit is 50, while the legacy list uses 100.
2. Child sessions are not discoverable from the main sidebar unless the parent session is opened.

Could the UI expose the total number of child sessions or provide a clear way to browse them? Also, please verify pagination/rendering for projects with several hundred active sessions.

The upstream fix is now released. Could OpenCode V2 update its OpenTUI dependencies to include it?

- OpenTUI PR https://github.com/anomalyco/opentui/pull/1442 ("markdown: fix hyperlink rendering and detection") was merged on September 4, 2026.
- It shipped in OpenTUI **v0.5.11** on September 7: https://github.com/anomalyco/opentui/releases/tag/v0.5.11
- OpenCode **v2.0.5** still pins `@opentui/core`, `@opentui/solid`, and `@opentui/keymap` to **0.5.10** in its dependency catalog: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/v2.0.5/package.json

The upstream PR implements compact named links when OSC 8 is supported, with visible URL fallbacks otherwise. Is an OpenTUI dependency update planned for an upcoming OpenCode V2 release?

Update: opened a draft fix — #49418.

One correction to the suggested fix in the issue body above: I initially proposed just removing `"unknown"` from the loop's exclusion list entirely, but running the existing test suite showed that's too blunt — there's a deliberate test (`"loop continues when finish is unknown"`) covering a provider that drops its finish signal on an otherwise-healthy stream, where retrying once is the correct, intended behavior. The actual bug is that this retry has no upper bound. #49418 caps consecutive unresolved (`unknown`, no tool calls) retries at a small constant instead of changing when `unknown` is allowed to retry at all — keeps the existing recovery behavior intact and fixes the unbounded case.

I force-pushed this branch and rewrote its history. The earlier commits are withdrawn.

The previous versions of this PR changed the composer's default max height and clipped the prompt input. That was the wrong diagnosis: `Math.max(6, floor(height / 3))` only differs from `floor(height / 3)` below 18 rows, so it changed nothing at the terminal size where the issue was actually reported, and it did not touch the component at fault. Those commits also sat on a month-old base.

The branch is now a single commit on current `dev` containing only the real fix: the overflow comes from `UserMessage`'s bordered box, which renders past the scroll viewport because opentui skips the viewport's scissor rect for a fully transparent background.

Upstream note: the underlying behaviour is in `@opentui/core` 0.4.5 — `drawBox` ignores the active scissor rect when `backgroundColor` has alpha 0. Minimal reproduction, on a `204x52` buffer:

```ts
buffer.pushScissorRect(2, 0, 158, 44)          // rows 0..43
buffer.drawBox({ x: 2, y: -20, width: 158, height: 73, border: ["left"], borderColor: FG, backgroundColor: bg })
buffer.popScissorRect()
```

With an opaque `bg` the border is clipped at row 43. With `alpha = 0` it paints all the way to row 51. `shouldFill` and custom border characters make no difference. Happy to open a separate issue upstream if that is useful.

```
The blocker isn't in this repo's build config, it's upstream in Bun.
opencode ships as a Bun-compiled binary (packages/opencode/script/build.ts:163 uses Bun.build with compile.target), and Bun's CompileTarget/Architecture only supports x64, arm64/aarch64 — there is no 32-bit ARM target. So arm32 (armv7/armhf) support has to land in Bun itself first (there's longstanding demand for it, e.g. oven-sh/bun#75 and RPi use cases). Even then you'd need:
1. Add arch: "arm" / armv7 entries to allTargets (build.ts:53) — the mechanical part, trivial.
2. The native runtime deps bundled at build time (@parcel/watcher, @ff-labs/fff-bun, @opentui/core, tree-sitter parsers) to ship arm32 prebuilds via the bun install --os="*" --cpu="*" step (build.ts:141-144). Most don't publish armhf binaries today.
So realistically: upstream Bun would need to add arm32 cross-compilation support, and the native dep chain would need armhf prebuilds. Short of that, arm64-on-arm32 won't help (Pi via 64-bit OS already works).
```
